note: Errata 163 A8: the whole district, laid out by the builder from the game's plates and docs (Tyler, 2026-11-07: "Feel free to create a completely new map if you need to where everything on the whole map should be located. Paths, mountains, places, buildings, etc."). Coordinates are the map's 1920 x 864 pixels, north up, the map's view from the south and a little above. tools/art/district-blockout.py paints it; the image session dresses the painting; content/rooms/town-map.json's markers and roads are read from here, so they land where the drawing does.

reading.valley: Every exterior plate shows the town in a valley ringed by mountains (Room 1, 2, 22, 29).
reading.pass: Room 1: the coach stop is on a mountain road above the town's lamps, which lie below and to the left (south-west). The road comes down from a pass; Thad walks down into the town's east end (Room 2's stage_road arrival).
reading.main_street: Room 2: an open square of mud. Along its north side, facing south, west to east: the mercantile, the Improvement Company (the biggest in the row), the Clarion, the notice board's gap, two fronts, two set further back, and one with a porch right beside the Nugget. Down the square's east side, facing west: the Nugget (the grandest, at the corner), the hotel and the assay office. The L's two arms are about equal (Tyler). The road out leaves past the assay office, north-east. The alley at the west end leads to the Lane.
reading.the_lane: Room 44: behind Main Street's row, from its west-end alley, five shopfronts facing it (undertaker's, photographer's, Ozymandia's tent, barber's, empty storefront); through to Lower Street at its far end.
reading.lower_street: Room 43: east of Main Street up the road: the Registrar's, the back-alley mouth, the church with its belfry and the bell on its post, the passage to the Lane, the livery with its corral; its east end is the road out of town and the coach road's foot. It runs east of the square's east arm, up the road from the square's south-east corner.
reading.back_alley: Room 20: behind Lower Street's west end, crates, barrels, a rain barrel; the watchman's shack at its far end (Room 21).
reading.claims_road: Room 22: across the creek's bridge, a signpost junction; the town in the valley to the west, the road climbing east into the hills.
reading.boot_hill: Room 14: a fenced graveyard on a hill, the town's lights below to the south-west.
reading.diggings: Prosperity (23) is a hill with a hole; Pratt's claim (25) is next door, a cabin and a sluice; the creek and sluice (26); the abandoned claim row (27), stakes along a gulch; Sheng's laundry (28) by the water; the high ridge (29), a cairn high above town and diggings; Mott's site (30) far out, pocked ground and a windlass, the town just visible.
